acceptance.scope: exact copied 0.172.0 /189 candidate native runtime with development-file/outbound-IP denial; public commands

recorded_index_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public seek/speed/step and boundary commands; native presentation revision/viewport fields excluded explicitly. These cases do not invoke the UI callback or claim new physical typing. Source/mounted regressions separately establish first-action field settlement, refusal/correction, boundary drafting and ownership guards.

recording_final_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public import/Open commands preserve dirty editor, viewer, graph, physics and history; no new physical input or authentication of arbitrary solver history

terminal_validation_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public loader/recovery commands and fresh saves; no physical input, automatic startup recovery or original recording-import crash claim

integration_discovery_commands.scope: Exact copied /180 native endpoint and headless agent public commands; no physical input, solver change or visible-latency claim

geometry_action_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public editor.value.set then Rotate/Undo/Duplicate/Undo on six incomplete one-part graphs. Configured values stay unchanged. Copy IDs are compared under one sentinel because lifetime reservations differ. Private field/one-click/deferred/held guards are separately source-mounted, not new physical OS input or this API sequence.

pinned_file_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public commands; original /177 bytes, new saves, controlled lease-retired recovery. No physical input, crash, automatic-warning or visible-latency claim.

floating_source_commands.scope: Exact copied native/agent public construction, Step, switch and low input; preserved history; eight fresh agent save/reopens. No new physical input or visible latency claim.

sweep_capture_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public sweep.start settings, captured metadata and complete curves. Thirty source retained-widget/deferred cases qualify private field settlement separately; this does not assert physical OS sweep typing on these package bytes.

value_correction.scope: Exact copied native endpoint and headless packaged agent public commands; prior native typing/Apply evidence is a separate development-binary observation

preset_value_commands.scope: Copied native/headless public component.set commands for the four preset values; UI field handoff is separately qualified by retained-widget source regressions, not this API sequence

verification_handoff_commands.scope: Exact copied native and headless public commands. No native private-field settlement or new OS input claim; those retained-widget source tests remain separately scoped.

coil_startup_reset_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public settings projection and captures; production reset input is separately qualified by retained-widget and semantic source regressions. No new physical OS input claim.

component_startup_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public commands, six 1 ms steps and RC/RL laws, eight fresh saved reopens. UI private draft settlement is separately qualified by 34 source-mounted cases; no physical OS startup input claim.

appearance_job_checks.scope: Exact copied native socket and packaged headless stdio commands; no accepted held-IO cancellation or physical UI claim

discovery_commands.scope: Exact copied native/headless public discovery and behavior. Native layout can advance presentation/revision fields during queries; every other field is compared. Source query-purity and private input evidence remain separate; no physical OS/reader/IME or exhaustive semantic acceptance claim.

live_measurement_ownership.scope: Exact copied native/headless public commands; private native draft reset is separately proven by the two pinned-source mounted ownership regressions

recorded_cursors.scope: Exact copied native endpoint and matching headless agent commands on one identical saved capture; mounted one-click input/settlement is separately proven by pinned source regressions

recording_targets.scope: Exact copied native/headless commands on two distinct saved captures; source mounted tests separately prove private-edit reset across capture selection

reference_parity.comparison: Every component/wire field; every reported result field except run/electrical identities; numerical rel 1e-9 / abs 1e-12
limitations: Native endpoint loading/observation does not replace the recorded physical UI construction walkthrough
File failure, crash recovery, cancellation and live interaction have separate acceptance checks

limits: Public command functionality; not new pointer/keyboard evidence or visible p95 qualification

Earlier retained-control and output-page checks retain their recorded scope. Schematic pointer and keyboard refusal/fresh actions are tested after actual native mesh preparation by semantic injection in the copied-runtime smoke. Standalone Cogent key-binding tests cover replacement refusal, own repeats, navigation/Escape, guarded states and public move/Undo parity. This is not physical NSEvent evidence. Earlier physical UI evidence remains scoped to its recorded build; no physically coalesced OS input/window-blur or visible-latency claim.

archive.scope: Unqualified local candidate ZIP/extraction/headless-example rehearsal only; no release receipt, extracted native startup, ordinary OS/default-startup or native click qualification

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or V; m/u/µ/μ prefixes, for example 500 mV or 1 V

matching_parts.limitations: Ideal DC voltage source; positive minus negative sets its voltage, and either terminal may be above/below ground in a referenced network. No output resistance, current limit, battery discharge, noise, heating, ratings or physical part identity.

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or Ω/ohm; k/K/M prefixes, for example 2.2k or 0.1M Ω

matching_parts.limitations: Ideal constant resistance; no tolerance, heating, parasitics, ratings or physical part identity. Current is positive from pin 1 to pin 2.
matching_parts.name: Resistor

matching_parts.limitations: Educational generic diode; no physical part identity, reverse breakdown, thermal dynamics, ratings, or calibrated brightness.
matching_parts.name: Red LED

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or F; p/n/u/µ/μ/m prefixes, for example 1 µF or 100nF

matching_parts.limitations: Ideal capacitor with configurable initial voltage; no ESR, leakage, polarity, heating, ratings or physical part identity. Voltage and current use pin 1 relative to pin 2.
matching_parts.name: Capacitor

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or H; n/u/µ/μ/m prefixes, for example 10 mH or 100uH

matching_parts.limitations: Ideal constant inductance with configurable signed initial current; voltage pin 1 minus pin 2, current into pin 1/out of pin 2, energy L I² / 2. matching_parts.name: Inductor

value_domain.relation: Amplitude plus the absolute offset must be ≤12 V.
